excludedHarnessError.explanation: Local result variable shadowed the formal() helper; fixed only verifier script and reran this one scenario. Original FAIL remains unchanged and is not a product failure.

main.scope: B04 third repair: remaining F04-11 and directly affected regressions; no product edits by reviewers

builderArchives.sideEffect: Existing npm test rewrites both B04-http-evidence.json and B04-repair3-merge-payload.json. Submitted files were copied before execution.

builderMergeEvidenceDocument.note: Documentary evidence discrepancy only; not counted as a product defect. Independent HTTP evidence determines functional verdict.

productFingerprintComparison.note: All four full product fingerprints in repair3 report match actual submitted files. Full runtime freeze belongs to independent HTTP report.

browser.reason: No UI source changes in this repair; change concerns backend aggregation and summary input. Reuse prior real-browser evidence and run affected backend checks. Npm UI tests are not real browser evidence.

realProvider.reason: No user-configured existing server-side product Provider/model/key. Presence-only check recorded; no real credential values read.

documentaryEvidence.note: Documentary evidence discrepancy only; not counted as a product defect. Independent HTTP evidence determines functional verdict.

realProvider.reason: No user-configured product Provider/model/key; only presence indicators read.

notRun: Real Provider success/semantic quality/real long text
Unchanged UI real-browser repeat (prior UI fingerprint equal)
Unchanged full B02/B03/60s timeout/10min deadline/error/fault/cancel/delete matrix
